title: 第3章 技惊四座绝无可能第4章 开始优化五雷咒给我变
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
“功德值功能？”
林凡在心中询问过后，顿时心中激动。
这新功能，竟然是优化道术？
好比说，五雷咒已然是大圆满境界，技能点无法再提升道术的境界。
但只要消耗功德值，便会把五雷咒优化成更高的层次！
有挂！
这是挂上加挂啊！
林凡连忙在心中问道：“系统，优化五雷咒需要多少点功德值？”
【系统提示：优化五雷咒，需要功德五十点！】
“够了！”
林凡眼睛一亮，这不巧了吗？
刚杀的五只黑僵，正好赚了五十功德点。
没等林凡多想，结结巴巴的声音把他从思绪中勾回了现实。
“这……这……”
文才嘴角抽搐了一下，这才从刚才的雷鸣中缓过神来。
呆望着眼前没了气息，五头焦黑的僵尸，吓得脸色苍白。
“多亏师……”
秋生猛回头，“父”字都没来得及说出。
只见一张熟悉的，棱角分明剑目星眉的脸，浮现在眼前。
大师兄林凡？！

秋生惊讶得目瞪口呆，仿佛整个世界都在旋转。
此间嘴巴张大的仿佛，都可以吞下整个宇宙一般。
自己与文才一起收拾一头黑僵，都要费九牛二虎之力。
林凡是强一些，让他对付一头黑僵尚可，两头恐怕也是无能为力。
如今，倒在自己面前的可是整整5只黑僵。
还是瞬间被击溃的五只黑僵。
好比之前一个婴儿，他只能走路步伐中还摇摇晃晃不能控制自如。
如今仅仅过了数月，婴儿不但能行走自如还学会了奔跑。
还有，方才那五雷咒是怎么回事？
这等迅猛强悍的雷，也只在师父处见识过。
“师兄，师父怎么了？”
文才缓缓抬起脑袋，瞟了眼秋生，面带恐惧低声问道。
秋生只是呆若木鸡，一脸惊恐，没有回应。
“完了！”
文才见状，心中暗道不好。
师兄向来胆子大，尚且吓成这个样子。
师父这会得气坏了，怪不得刚才的五雷咒，凶猛得吓人。
这回少不了挨罚了！
“师父，全都怪秋生，是他……”
文才缩着脖子，面带苦涩缓缓转过头去。

话还没说完，忽然傻住！
眼前人哪里是什么九叔？
站在面前的，分明是大师兄，林凡！
content_en:
"Merit value function?"
After Lin Fan asked in his mind, he suddenly felt excited.
This new function is actually an optimization of Taoism?
For example, the Five Thunder Curse is already at the Great Perfection state, and skill points cannot improve the state of Taoism.
But as long as the merit points are consumed, the Five Thunder Curse will be optimized to a higher level!
Something is wrong!
This is hanging on and off!
Lin Fan quickly asked in his mind: "System, how many merit points are needed to optimize the Five Thunder Curse?"
[System prompt: Optimizing the Five Thunder Spell requires fifty points of merit! 】
"Enough!"
Lin Fan's eyes lit up. Isn't this a coincidence?
The five black zombies I just killed earned me exactly fifty merit points.
Before Lin Fan could think about it, a stammering voice brought him back to reality from his thoughts.
"This...this..."
The corner of Wen Cai's mouth twitched, and he finally recovered from the thunder just now.
Staring blankly at the five lifeless zombies in front of him, his face turned pale with fear.
"Thank you, Master..."
Qiu Sheng turned around sharply, and he didn't even have time to say the word "father".
I saw a familiar face with sharp angular sword eyes and star eyebrows appeared in front of my eyes.
Senior brother Lin Fan? !
Qiu Sheng was stunned with surprise, as if the whole world was spinning.
The mouth here is so wide open that it seems like it can swallow the entire universe.
It would take a lot of effort for both himself and Wencai to clean up a black zombie.
Lin Fan was stronger, so he could handle one black zombie, but he might be powerless against the other two.
Now, there were five black zombies lying in front of him.
The five black zombies were defeated instantly.
Just like the previous baby, he could only walk with a wobbly pace and could not control himself.
Now, just a few months later, the baby can not only walk freely but also learn to run.
Also, what happened to the Five Thunder Curse just now?
Such swift and powerful thunder has only been seen by Master.
"Brother, what's wrong with master?"
Wencai slowly raised his head, glanced at Qiu Sheng, and asked in a low voice with fear on his face.
Qiu Sheng was just dumbfounded, with a look of horror on his face, and did not respond.
"It's over!"
When Wen Cai saw this, he secretly thought something bad.
Senior brother has always been very courageous, yet he was so scared.
The master was very angry now. No wonder the Five Thunder Curse just now was so fierce and terrifying.
This time I will inevitably be punished!
"Master, it's all Qiu Sheng's fault, it's him..."
Wencai shrank his neck and slowly turned his head with a bitter look on his face.
Before I finished speaking, I suddenly stopped!
Where is the uncle in front of me?
The person standing in front of me is clearly Senior Brother, Lin Fan!
